templates.why_chosen: Star, rank-6 canonical exemplar: five circled numbers trace a path through the Skyloft LibOS core, a Scheduling Policy pill-stack sits beside it, and a dotted line marks the user/kernel boundary above the hardware band.
templates.what_to_learn: Run a numbered path through the core's internal submodules and draw interchangeable scheduling policies as a stack of index-card pills beside it; but number branches only when they truly form one sequence; here steps 2/3 split from the scheduler while 4/5 arrive independently from hardware, so the numbering reads as separate paths, not one flow.
